label: Synthetic submitted-answer comparison
construct: Exercise exact-answer grading and paired reporting; not model capability.
sampling: Four deliberately authored contract examples, not a random sample. Each world is one problem unit.
exclusions: No inference to other tasks, model rankings, or weight effects.
stopping_rule: Analyze all four cases once; retain missing answers in the denominator.

families.construct: Membership in explicitly allowed answer alternatives.
families.rights: Original project-authored examples; no external dataset incorporated.
